title: Artifact Ledger entry
description: One artifact in the Artifact Ledger: what arrived, where its copy is, its status and an append-only history of every status change (ADR-0006, ADR-0015). Code owns every field. Never sent to an LLM provider.

schema_version.description: Version (MAJOR.MINOR) of this Ledger entry schema. A status change raises it to the current minor version of the same major.

title.description: The first Markdown heading, or the file name stem. Set by the Sensor (intake and input guardrail).

type.description: How the artifact arrived. Connectors add values later.

name.description: The original file name only, never a full path.

artifact_date.description: The date the artifact describes, when the Operator (human in the loop) gives it at intake.

media_type.description: Absent when the format is unsupported.

size_bytes.description: Size of the file as received.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the bytes after removing a UTF-8 byte order mark and normalizing line endings to LF. Used for duplicate detection.

stored_path.description: Path of the read-only copy, relative to the memory folder. Present for accepted, quarantined, processed, failed and held; absent for rejected.

same_name_as.description: Earlier entries with exactly the same source name, in ascending order. Not a claim that this is a revision.

governor.description: The Governor (orchestrator) run whose reply was accepted and saved as the work orders file. Present from then on, for processed, failed, held, and accepted after a release from held. Added in 1.2.

definitions.description: The register definition versions in the Governor's prompt, in register order.

run_id.description: The run that called the Governor; the run_id of the work orders file.

work_orders.description: How many work orders the Governor found per register, in register order; registers with none are left out.

routed.description: Whether the register has a Registrar, so its work orders are drafted.

produced.description: Records written or revised from this artifact. Empty unless the status is processed, or failed with a governor block (the results before the error).

rejected.description: Governor replies, drafts and comparisons that were rejected, kept across every later status change. Empty until a run lists one.

history.description: Every status change, oldest first. Append-only.

artifact_id.description: Artifact Ledger ID, for example ART-0001. Assigned by code.

status.description: Artifact statuses from ADR-0006. held is added in 1.2.

produced_record.description: One record this artifact created or revised. model and prompt_version are the Registrar's draft.

work_order.description: The number of the work order that produced the record. Added in 1.2; absent before the Governor (orchestrator).

record_id.description: The record written: the new record for new and supersession, the revised record for update and reaffirmation.

change.description: The change code applied. Absent in entries written before version 1.1, where it means new.

related_id.description: The record superseded. Present only for supersession.

comparison.description: The Comparator (reconciliation) run that classified the draft. Absent when the register had no active record to compare with.

candidates.description: The records the Comparator was shown, in Rerank order, with their Rerank relevance scores.

rejected_draft.description: A Governor reply, draft or comparison that failed its checks, listed without its error messages: evidence errors quote the model's reply, which is unvalidated model text.

register.description: Required unless the stage is governor, whose reply covers every register.

work_order.description: The number of the work order the draft was for. Added in 1.2; absent before the Governor (orchestrator) and for the governor stage.

stage.description: Where it was rejected: by the Governor's checks, the Registrar's or the Comparator's. Absent means draft. governor is added in 1.2.

error_paths.description: JSON paths of the last attempt's errors, for example $.evidence[1]. Just $ when the last response was unusable.

error_type.description: Project exception class name, present when the last response was unusable, for example LLMResponseError.

run_id.description: The run that rejected it. Without a work_order, the run_id of a processed history entry.

by.description: Who made the change. The Governor (orchestrator) makes every processing change from 1.2; pipeline stood in for it before and stays valid in earlier history.

check.description: The Sensor check that rejected or quarantined the artifact.

reason.description: Why, written by code or by the Operator; never artifact text or model output.

run_id.description: The run whose LLM events belong to this change (processed, failed and held only). For held, the run that called the Governor.

error_type.description: Project exception class name (failed only), for example LLMRateLimitError.
